headline: Muthoot Microfin Posts Record Disbursements and Profit Jump in Q2
summary: Muthoot Microfin reported record loan disbursements and a 3.6-fold jump in profit after tax for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, driven by improving asset quality.
why: Muthoot Microfin is a prominent microfinance institution whose earnings reflect rural credit demand and repayment trends in India.

impacts.name: Financial Services
impacts.why: Strong disbursement growth and improved asset quality directly enhance profitability for microfinance lenders.
